description: MetaRalph Phase 11: Autonomous Marketing - Content generation, social media, changelog management, community engagement.

userStories.title: Implement changelog generator
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to generate changelogs from completed PRDs and commits.
acceptanceCriteria: src/marketing/changelog.ts exports ChangelogGenerator class
Parses git commits since last release
Groups by: Features, Bug Fixes, Performance, Documentation
Generates human-readable descriptions from commit messages
Updates CHANGELOG.md in project
Supports: Keep a Changelog format, conventional commits
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement release notes generator
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to create polished release notes for new versions.
acceptanceCriteria: src/marketing/release-notes.ts exports ReleaseNotesGenerator class
Uses Claude to write engaging release notes from changelog
Highlights key features and improvements
Includes migration notes if breaking changes
Generates multiple formats: markdown, HTML, plain text
Can include screenshots and GIFs
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement documentation updater
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to keep project documentation up to date.
acceptanceCriteria: src/marketing/docs-updater.ts exports DocsUpdater class
Detects outdated docs by comparing with code
Updates README with new features and usage
Generates API documentation from code
Updates CLI help and man pages
Creates tasks for major doc rewrites
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement social media content generator
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to generate social media posts for releases and updates.
acceptanceCriteria: src/marketing/social.ts exports SocialMediaGenerator class
Generates: Twitter/X threads, LinkedIn posts, dev.to articles
Content tailored to platform character limits and style
Includes relevant hashtags and mentions
Requires user approval before posting
Scheduling support for optimal posting times
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement GitHub release publisher
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to create and publish GitHub releases.
acceptanceCriteria: src/marketing/github-release.ts exports GitHubReleasePublisher class
Creates GitHub release with: tag, title, release notes, assets
Bumps version in package.json following semver
Attaches build artifacts if configured
Creates draft release for review before publishing
Notifies user when release is ready for review
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement community engagement tracker
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to monitor and respond to community engagement.
acceptanceCriteria: src/marketing/community.ts exports CommunityEngagement class
Monitors: GitHub issues, discussions, stars, forks
Identifies: unanswered questions, popular feature requests
Suggests responses using Claude
Creates tasks from recurring feature requests
Tracks community health metrics over time
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement marketing coordinator
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to orchestrate marketing activities around releases.
acceptanceCriteria: src/marketing/index.ts exports MarketingEngine class
onRelease(project, version) triggers marketing pipeline
Pipeline: changelog -> release notes -> docs -> social -> GitHub release
Requires approval before publishing external content
'metaralph release <project> [version]' triggers release workflow
Dashboard shows: MarketingView with pending content, scheduled posts
Typecheck passes
